card.name: Colon after WARNING heading
card.fires_on: The colon right after the heading WARNING or WARNINGS on a drug label. Also weakly fires in a web error-style message, "Sorry, there are not enough data points".

modes.label: Warning heading colon
modes.description: The colon following WARNING or WARNINGS that starts a label warning section.
modes.example: WARNINGS WARNING<<:>> NOT FOR INTRAVENOUS USE

modes.label: Chart error message
modes.description: Words inside a web notice saying there is not enough data to plot a chart.
modes.example: Sorry, there are not enough<< data>> points to plot this chart.

card.writes: Suppresses the word error and its variants; no strong positive theme.
card.plain: It lights up on the colon after a WARNING heading, just before the warning text begins.
